status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Cowboys placed Davis (hip) on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
status.longComment: Davis underwent surgery Saturday for a hip injury, and Calvin Watkins of The Dallas Morning News reports that the procedure will sideline the 27-year-old running back for the entire 2026 season. With Davis on the shelf, the Cowboys bolstered their backfield depth by signing Israel Abanikanda from the practice squad to the active roster, with the latter serving as the RB3 behind Javonte Williams and Emari Demercado.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Cowboys placed Smith (thumb) on injured reserve Wednesday.
status.longComment: Smith is scheduled to miss four to six weeks to recover from a procedure on his injured thumb. He'll be required to miss at least the Cowboys' next four games, so the earliest that the fifth-year offensive lineman can play is Week 5 against the Buccaneers on Thursday, Oct. 8. T.J. Bass will serve as the Cowboys' starting left guard for as long as Smith is sidelined.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Coach Brian Schottenheimer said Monday that Overshown is expected to miss 1-to-2 weeks due to the hamstring injury he sustained during Sunday's loss against the Giants, Andrew Siciliano of NFL Network reports.
status.longComment: Overshown was forced out of the Cowboys' regular-season opener early with a hamstring issue, and it seems like he'll likely have to sit out at least one game as he recovers. Any time he spends on the sidelines could open up additional time at linebacker for rookie third-round pick Jaishawn Barham.

status.label: Doubtful
status.shortComment: Hooker was diagnosed with a forearm fracture after undergoing tests Monday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
status.longComment: The safety left Sunday's loss to the Giants in the fourth quarter and did not return. He seems likely to miss at least two weeks, according to Calvin Watkins of The Dallas Morning News.  P.J. Locke and Markquese Bell would be the next two up at safety if Hooker has to sit for an extended period.
